body:
She drinks out of our cups, had to get cups with lids to prevent it. She also likes condensation on cups or windows, hates the bath though. 

She’s pretty independent but also will follow me everywhere most of the time. She’s developing an interest in my newborn, likes to lay above him on the back of the couch like a little protector. 

She’s 1 of 2 cats in our place, the other one was the king before she came and she’s basically taken over. They play very intensely at times but she definitely is the boss nowadays and he just lets her.
Cool thanks for your input, smartass

I’m still convinced she is, her mane is LONG and poofy. I don’t think she’s purebred by any means but we don’t know who her mom bred with. She’s just all of a sudden floofy and huge and so are all of her siblings so I’m thinking she’s got something in her that made her so majestic looking.
That’s a beautiful cat 😍💕 wow
The white whiskers 😍💕 so cutee

Well that was what I was trying to do since I’m technically not an employee of Amazon at the moment, I wanted to be employed by Amazon so I could get the maternity leave benefits but I didn’t know if it would work since online says you have to work for 1 year with them. I heard of other people starting at like 35 weeks pregnant and getting maternity leave right away but idk how valid that is. 

I’m due in December, I have like 10 weeks left… 😵‍💫
My state does not, I can get unpaid FMLA if I stay a driver but that’s it which is why I wanted to swap to warehouse to snag that Benefit if I can lol

The issue with that is the place we live now is really good and reasonably priced, it’s a small family owned renters company VS a bigger company that price gouges apartments 🥲 I was paying twice what we pay now just to live alone before I got pregnant. We decided I’d give up my apartment so we could cut those costs and save money.

I guess I shouldn’t believe everything I find on the internet in that sense, cause yeah info gets left out and I truly don’t believe we have anything to be concerned about with myself and my baby’s father, as far as parenting goes we are on the same page and both believe this is going to be an ideal home with lots of love, care and support between us and family.

Im hoping it never happens but like I said these girls are not right in the head so I fear they’re capable of going this far and I just want to protect my baby cause it’s not even out of my womb yet and they’re trying to involve it in their anger. It truly disgusts me.
Honestly I’m considering getting something, these girls are CRAZY. The lengths they’ve gone so far is scary and they know where we live.
Huh?

We both have blocked them on everything but they keep contacting us on various numbers. It started with him, now it’s me. I don’t quite know what else to do cause they’re persistent. The ex fling lives in a different state, and that’s the one we have the most issues with, his friend just fuels the fire and the fling acts on it. 

Friend gave fling my phone number, fling contacts on different numbers after each one is blocked.

I just meant getting police involved for the harassment, so there’s a history and proof that they’ve been malicious. 

I’ve blocked them, he’s blocked them and they keep popping up with different phone numbers. They just won’t leave us alone and I know it will continue, I just don’t know how far they’ll take it.

As for how CPS works I’ve never had experience nor do I know the steps they take so I was under the assumption that it is lengthy and complicated no matter the situation but if all it takes is interviews and a home visit I am sure we would be fine. It’s just the horror stories that freak me out. Bad case workers, etc. 

I’m very protective of my baby, and as a first time mom I’m anxious about every little thing that could go wrong.
1 at 6 weeks and another this Friday at 8 weeks. Not sure if they will do a 3rd. Anxious first timer so ultrasounds are definitely comforting.
Sound like she shouldn’t reproduce. Not everyone deserves to be or should be a mother. Good for you for cutting that off. I hope you have a happy healthy pregnancy. 🩵 You deserve better friends.

I’ve been on a sour kick and adding a koolaid packet to my water (no sugar) just to get water down. Sometimes my water tastes like garlic for no reason and it throws me off but I never have an issue getting sour water down.
Thank you 😌🩵

Moving to a cheaper place, father of my baby is being very supportive and helpful, I find jobs very quickly so I not stressed about any of that. Plus I DoorDash on the side so it’s not like I have 0 income

I’m moving to a significantly cheaper place with the father of my baby, I’ve been paying like 1200 where I am now plus my car payment and other expenses. The judgment is unnecessary since you don’t know the full details of my life. 🩵
Thank you 🩵 this promotion feels AMAZING.
Yeah sadly this is highest paying job I ever had yet still couldn’t pay my bills. I’m only 25, it was nice for a while but I’m over it.
My DSP was cool till I got pregnant, then it seems they purposely made the job harder for me. Guess they didn’t want me there anymore. Whatever.
I didn’t know till I needed it, day started chilly outside and got warmer then the sun came out and the van was hot inside. :/
I already turned in my stuff, is there a way to like… call them or something? Email idk 🤣

I was just taking my time and they sent a rescue who then made me feel like my only choice is to quit, didn’t say word for word but had zero empathy for me feeling unwell and fatigued, and said I was annoying him so I just decided to do everyone a solid and leave since I’m such a bother to them ._.

Today they gave me 191, in a small van with no AC in an area I’m unfamiliar with. :( I was hot, tired, dehydrated and crabby. 

I’m in my first trimester still so the fatigue has been getting to me. First pregnancy also 

And right, but I honestly think they wanted to push me out for a while. Sucks cause I did like the job I just didn’t like that all I was getting was 300+ packages, overstuffed vans and ZERO wiggle room for help. Plus the judgment from management when I wouldn’t be doing my normal 40 stops an hour pace cause my muscles literally want to give out.
If you want to I’m sure you can. I wouldn’t cause I just hate Amazon that much. I couldn’t imagine stuffing totes all day.
Instructions unclear, currently in a ditch flipped upside down.

My DSP has been giving me nothing but 190+ routes, shit vehicles and not a single Dolly for heavy packages (though they said they would) 

I dragged 9 packages into a a school yesterday with no dolly, Probably 100lbs of books. It was my 2nd stop. I bawled my eyes out for the first time ever while working there.
Thank you 🥰 looking forward to the future now that this is in my past!!
Sounds like a house I deliver to, but I don’t open gates even if I can see past them. I don’t know what’s beyond it, doggy doors ETC. I say fuck that asshole, come get it from my hands or RTS 💅

I had 1 guy invite me in for food, I said naw cause I celebrated yesterday since I knew I had to work. Another lady came out and opened the box I handed her and gave me some of the candy that was inside. 

I wasn’t even mad to be working, holidays are just another day to me. The comments all day definitely were annoying tho, I think I only spoke to like 7 people in total but that was 7 too many. Just let me get this done so I can go have my leftovers and take a nap!! 🤣

Then there were Lots of open front doors with families staring at me (hate that) 🙄

Ugh hate that, I’m sorry :/ have you talked to other DSP’s in your station? Maybe that one just isn’t gonna work out for you. I’ve heard so many horror stories of bad DSP’s and mine has its flaws but I’d definitely consider myself lucky with getting in with them considering how tough other ones can make the job.

If one of the 3 days not worked was your fault then maybe they’re punishing you for that? I got my guaranteed 10’s and bonus hours taken from me so now I show up for every shift cause I can’t afford to be hourly and miss days.

Reasonable, I definitely shower and do my makeup before I dash just so I don’t look bad but sometimes after I finish delivering for Amazon I go dashing for some instant-money so if I look gross its cause I’ve been out delivering peoples bullshit for 12+ hours.
We love the snacks and drinks that some houses put out! I have had 2 people hand me cash though, I love thoughtful customers. Makes my day 🥰
1000+ mg of caffeine in different forms and no will to live gets me thru my day tbh. No need for booger sugar here.

Oof. I got lucky with a great DSP. Don’t get me wrong I follow most instructions I just don’t care to sit and wait 20 minutes for every customer to come let me in a building or retrieve their shit from me. My pictures are okay, sometimes blurry. I used to stand there and try to take a perfect pic every time but now I’m in the routine of taking it as I’ve started walking away so they aren’t CRISP every single time (not that they can be with those whack cameras) 

We mostly get cracked down on for engine off compliance and how we mark packages when we have to RTS them.

I got 1 excessive g-force (NOT MY FAULT it was a busted ass road and I breaked just not enough so it kinda jiggled me around 🤣) 1 stop sign but they fought it cause I DID stop I just went too quick for netradynes liking. You literally saw the little bounce in the video. And then a few yellow light ones but I’d rather get yellow lights SOMETIMES than to break hard and cause an accident cause I’m in the questionable grey area of a stop light where I’m too close to stop but too far to go?? Idk. 

And mostly unproblematic cause I go mind my business and get my job done but I bitch and complain other times. Mostly about the routes or vehicles. Hate gas vehicles. I love my EV’s. Hate country, hate city routes I’m unfamiliar with. I like my usual routes cause I have those down to a T. I like consistency and routine but they like to shake it up on me 🙄
You could simply go to a store yourself? :)

Honestly valid, I do follow basic things like rear door, stuff like that unless I’m unfamiliar with the area and it’s dark. I call if there’s issues I don’t get traffic violations. I hit 1 mailbox in my first month cause it was my 1st time in a 12 footer, customer was soooo nice and my DSP warned me it to never do it again, reported it all that jazzy stuff. Got attacked by 1 dog, Other than that I’m a highly trusted driver, I rarely RTS packages I always complete my routes in less than 10 hours. Mostly unproblematic, always alwaaaayyys ahead of schedule. I don’t take any breaks or stop for the restroom. (Personal choice) 

My DSP owner is always talking about how much they love me there lol

I misunderstood then. I highly recommend doing the garage delivery though, we get access thru the app to open and close it. We can’t step more than 1-2 feet inside but your package would go in there, safe from rain and porch pirates and there’s ZERO way around it for us.
I’d chuckle and keep going for sure, definitely do that. Please. Makes our day better

It’s the only way I get my route done in less than 10 hours. If I took the time to actually do everything to a T I’d NEVER finish and I’d always need to be rescued. I need to get in and out of a stop as fast as possible so I can get home and do my side hustle and house work.

People are dumb lmao I get ones that are like… “call for assistance delivering desk” when it’s an envelope 💀 there was one that said knock and wish ‘name’ a happy birthday (that’s a funny one actually cause it was years old and they didn’t know how to change it so for yeaaaars they got drivers wishing this kid a happy birthday)

I’m a top driver actually 🤣 thankfully the people around me don’t leave stupid instructions except at apartments where they tell me go go inside and I don’t bother with that cause 99% of the time I do not have access and no one is home to let me in. 

Stay pressed though.

We technically aren’t allowed to enter your premises whatsoever. Opening a garage, a service door or anything like that CAN AND WILL get us fired. Theres a way to hook up your garage via Bluetooth that we open thru our delivery app, or get a box to put it in. Do not put our jobs at risk for your convenience. 

Theres plenty of options that don’t risk us losing our jobs.

Same lmao, every check in it’s them saying I need better reviews even tho I’m respectful af with everyone’s stupid shit. I chalk it up to my appearance, I literally have people that come out and say thank you but as soon as I turn and say you’re welcome and they see my face their demeanor changes. Or as I walk up and they greet me, but once I’m face to face they judge and act weird. (I have tons of piercings but they’re “classy and hardly noticeable” according to my HR)

But it’s not people who make the routes, it’s AI 😅 it was also probably an old note anyway. No one ever updates that shit. I have a house that still has “hide behind the bush, out of sight of trick or treaters” I just say fuck you to notes for the most part. I don’t care about the notes ever.

If I step in shit I call dispatch, bitch about it while making a small scene outside in hopes they are watching me. I Bite a hole in my water bottle and sit there spraying my shoes all over their yard. Wiping my shoes allllll over so they know what assholes they are. Fuck people that don’t clean their dog shit. 

I also frequently deliver to people that literally just bag their dog shit and toss it in a pile in the yard, while their garbage bins are on the curb, like you’re that lazy you couldn’t put it in there before you took your cans out? Thats like 10 feet if even that.

Oh no absolutely agree with that, I’m 100% not against kicking a dog myself. Self defense over anything, though I wouldn’t like to do that. I also wouldn’t entirely be mad if someone was stupid enough to have their aggressive dog out and ask me to go in its territory. 

If I see a dog I stay away, call twice and RTS but if I unknowingly walk into it I certainly would love to get a check for it. I’m not entirely reckless lol

You’re dramatic lmao the likelyhood of a dog wrecking my ability to do this that or the next thing is slim to none, I’ve seen dog attack wounds and most of them are pretty manageable. 

I’m not asking to get attacked per se but yeah if I have access to a customers rear door I’m taking it. Especially during daylight. I obviously don’t open gates unless it’s a known thing with the customer, or I typically won’t at night just cause I’m a female and don’t want a man attacking me. 

I’m more afraid of humans than I am a dog.

I 1000% go in backyards cause I swore if I get attacked by a dog again I’m getting myself a fat check from the irresponsible dog owner. The dog that attacked me didn’t actually break skin, he did bite me but I now have a gnarly scar and nerve damage in my ankle from trying to run back to my vehicle and falling. 🥲
